channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Noodles & Company: $7 Regular Ramen with Code RAMEN7
item.guid: Noodles & Company-$7 Regular Ramen with Code RAMEN7-2026-11-11
item.description: Any regular-sized ramen bowl for $7 through November 15: enter code RAMEN7 at noodles.com checkout or give the code at the counter. Open to everyone, no account needed; one per order, not on third-party delivery or catering, participating locations, while the chain's redemption cap lasts. The code and its terms are on Noodles' own offers terms page. (Through November 15, 2026)

item.title: Top Pick: Luna Grill: Club Luna Kids Eat Free: Free Kids Meal with Each Adult Entree, Dine-In
item.guid: Luna Grill-Club Luna Kids Eat Free: Free Kids Meal -2026-11-11
item.description: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, Club Luna Rewards members (free app account) get one free kids meal per adult entree, up to two per check, for children 10 and under, dine-in only with the child present. Show the offer in the Luna Grill app when ordering. All locations except San Diego Airport; not combinable with other offers. (SoCal & Texas only) (Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays)

item.title: Waba Grill: $5 Chicken Bowl Anniversary Day
item.guid: Waba Grill-$5 Chicken Bowl Anniversary Day-2026-11-11
item.description: Announced by email on 2026-11-11, a regular chicken bowl with rice or rice and veggies is $5 plus tax at participating locations today only, in-store or online. (CA & Southwest only) (November 11, 2026 only)

item.title: Kroger: Sushi Wednesday: Snowfox Promo Rolls for $6
item.guid: Kroger-Sushi Wednesday: Snowfox Promo Rolls for-2026-11-11
item.description: Every Wednesday, Kroger-family stores with a Snowfox sushi counter (Kroger, Fry's, King Soopers and other banners) sell the Wednesday Only promo lineup, including spicy tuna, Philly, California and veggie rolls, for $6 a roll (up from $5 in 2025) versus $8 to $10 the rest of the week. Walk in; a free Kroger Plus card may be needed for the promo price. (Select states only) (Wednesdays only)

item.title: Publix: $5 Sushi Wednesday: Select Fresh Rolls for $5
item.guid: Publix-$5 Sushi Wednesday: Select Fresh Rolls f-2026-11-11
item.description: Every Wednesday at Publix stores with a sushi counter, select fresh-made rolls (spicy tuna, California, spicy shrimp, cream cheese/Philadelphia-style, vegetable and more; selection varies by store) are $5 each instead of the usual $6 to $10. Walk in and grab them from the sushi case: no app, coupon, or membership needed, while supplies last. (FL & Southeast only) (Wednesdays only)

item.title: Corner Bakery Cafe: Choose Two for $8.99 with Code 1551: Half Salad, Soup, Sandwich or Pasta Plus a Side
item.guid: Corner Bakery Cafe-Choose Two for $8.99 with Code 1551: Hal-2026-11-11
item.description: Limited time at select cafes: any Choose Two combo (two of a half salad, half soup, half sandwich or half pasta) plus a side for $8.99, all day. Enter code 1551 at online checkout or mention it in the cafe; no account needed, not valid on third-party delivery. The offer is set cafe by cafe: it shows for Fair Oaks in Fairfax, Bethesda, both DC cafes and cafes in Illinois, Texas, Georgia, Pennsylvania and Tennessee, so pick your cafe on Corner Bakery's offers page to confirm before you go. (Select cafes: DC, MD, VA, IL, TX, GA, PA & TN only) (Limited time)

item.title: Yoshinoya: $5 Off Two Regular Rice Bowls with Code CE41FLDF
item.guid: Yoshinoya-$5 Off Two Regular Rice Bowls with Code -2026-11-11
item.description: Standing coupon on Yoshinoya's own coupons page: add two regular rice bowls (chicken, beef or veggie) in-store, online or in the app and apply code CE41FLDF at checkout for $5 off; no account needed. Not valid on ribeye, salmon or limited-time items; participating locations. The same page lists $5 off two large bowls (code CRSA6MCE), $5 off two combo bowls (C6Z88J4A) and 20% off $20 (C9M7P979), 25% off $25 (C3FBHN3D) or 30% off $30 (up to $10 off). (California only only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Schlotzsky's: BOGO Wednesday: Buy One Pizza, Flatbread or Calzone, Get One Free
item.guid: Schlotzsky's-BOGO Wednesday: Buy One Pizza, Flatbread-2026-11-11
item.description: Every Wednesday, all day: buy any pizza, flatbread or calzone and get a second of equal or lesser value free, in the restaurant, in the app or online (some stores run it in-app only; the discount shows after checkout online). One free item per order, excludes kids' pizzas, extra toppings and gluten-free crust; cannot be combined with other offers or banked rewards. No account needed. Stated in Schlotzsky's own BOGO Wednesday FAQ. (24 states (TX, South & Midwest) only) (Wednesdays only)

item.title: Tijuana Flats: Veterans Day: 50% Off Adult Entree (Code VETDAY26)

item.description: Veterans and active-duty military with valid ID get 50% off the lowest-priced adult entree in-store today only with a $9.99 minimum purchase, mention code VETDAY26 at checkout. (FL & Southeast only) (November 11, 2026 only)

item.title: Panera Bread: Buy $50 in Gift Cards, Get a Free $10 Bonus Card
item.guid: Panera Bread-Buy $50 in Gift Cards, Get a Free $10 Bo-2026-11-11

item.guid: Playa Bowls-Free 16 oz Cold Brew with a Chocolate Co-2026-11-11

item.title: Moe's Southwest Grill: Free Birria Grilled Burrito Dipper with Any Purchase for Moe Rewards Members
item.guid: Moe's Southwest Grill-Free Birria Grilled Burrito Dipper with -2026-11-11
